source_locator.short_quote: Mars ... takes the next two signs ... Aries and Scorpio

condition.house_pair_source: Book I Chapter XX main text

normalized_rule: Ptolemy's Chapter XX assigns Mars the two houses Aries and Scorpio; the cited edition's footnote 49 orders Aries as day and Scorpio as night.
synthesis_notes: This is a source-specific house lookup, not a guaranteed personality or event outcome.
review_notes: Pairs with the existing Sun and Moon house rules. The main text supports Mars's two signs; the day/night order is an edition footnote/modern overlay, not silently attributed to Ptolemy. 'Domicile' remains normalized technique vocabulary.
transmission_notes: Chapter XX's main text assigns Mars's two signs. Footnote 49 says the day/night table is from Whalley and also found in modern writers; preserve that editorial/modern overlay separately from the Ptolemaic two-house assignment.
